# Components (fixture for the v2 prompt snapshot, ticket 073)

A fixed stand-in for `docs/components.md`, so the snapshot moves only when the prompt
template or the vocabulary files change, not when a component is added.

| component | tier | status | explainer smoke | hitech smoke | note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stamp` | 2 | implemented | b03 | b03 | a number or word slams in with a hit |
| `text_pop` | 2 | implemented | b04 | - | a keyword pops in with an overshoot |
| `map` | 2 | implemented | b05 | b05 | a map with labelled markers |
| `flash` | 2 | implemented | - | - | a white flash between shots |
| `whip` | 2 | implemented | - | - | a fast horizontal blur between shots |
| `cut` | 1 | implemented | - | - | |
